title: Poison set
html:
The Poison set is a set of equipment that helps the user do ⁠Poison damage or inflict  Poisoned. It consists of the following pieces:

Name Slot Effect

Argument Solver 		 Main Hand Melee (Greatclub)
 Poison Mist ()
On a hit, deal extra ⁠Poison damage equal to your proficiency bonus and surround the target in a noxious cloud that possibly  Poisons those within it. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

Armour of the Sporekeeper 		 Armour (Light Armour)
Malefic Funghi
The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and when dealing ⁠Necrotic damage, they deal an additional 1⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
Spore Sacks
While imbued with  Symbiotic Entity, you can spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores.

Broodmother's Revenge 		 Amulet
Venomous Revenge
Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage.

Cruel Sting 		 Main Hand Melee (Longsword)
Sting The Helpless
A Drow wielding this weapon deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Poison against  Restrained targets.
 Ensnaring Strands ()
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

Derivation Cloak 		 Cloak
Deadly Derivation
When you  Poison a foe, heal yourself for 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.

Djinni Scimitar 		 Main Hand Melee (Scimitar)
  • Deal an additional 2d10⁠⁠Poison damage.
  • Exploit only.

Handmaiden's Mace 		 Main Hand Melee (Mace)
  • Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Poison damage.
  • Set the wearer's Strength score to 18. The enchantment has no effect if their Strength score is higher without it.

Hellbeard Halberd 		 Main Hand Melee (Halberd)
  • Deal an additional 6⁠⁠Poison damage.

Infernal Mace 		 Main Hand Melee (Mace)
Infernal Weapon
On a hit, this weapon deals an additional 3⁠⁠Poison damage and can possibly  Poison its target.

Infernal Spear 		 Main Hand Melee (Spear)
Infernal Weapon
On a hit, this weapon deals an additional 3⁠⁠Poison damage and can possibly  Poison its target.

Poisoner's Gloves 		 Gloves (Non-Armour)
Envenom
Whenever you deal ⁠Poison damage, the target needs to succeed a  Constitution Saving Throw or become  Poisoned.

Poisoner's Ring 		 Ring
 Virulent Venom ()
Point your ringed finger at a target to make it vulnerable to ⁠Poison damage, unless it is immune to ⁠Poison damage. ( Recharge: Long rest.)

Poisoner's Robe 		 Armour (Clothing)
Poison Trails
When the wearer casts a spell that deals ⁠Poison damage, it deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage.

Staff of Crones 		 Main Hand Melee (Quarterstaff)
 Ray of Sickness ()
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Short rest.)

Syringe (+1) 		 Main Hand Melee (Dagger)
  • Bugged; the weapon action does not appear for the player.
 Inject Nostrum ()
Inject an enemy with the mysterious liquid in your syringe and possibly  Poison them. ( Recharge: Short rest.)

Thorn Blade 		 Main Hand Melee (Scimitar)
Poisonous Synergy
While concentrating, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Poison.
 Ensnaring Strike (Melee) ()
Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest.)
